title: The Baden-Württemberg-STIPENDIUM for Students
summary: Scholarship for highly qualified undergraduates, graduates, and doctoral students to spend 1 or 2 exchange semesters at partner institutions in Baden-Württemberg or abroad.

institutions.notes: institutions of higher education either in the federal state of Baden-Württemberg (Germany) or at their international partner institutions

nationality.notes: Country selection list is provided on the page, but no explicit unrestricted statement or complete iso list is given in text.

residence.notes: Scholars can be from Baden-Württemberg going abroad or candidates from abroad coming to Baden-Württemberg.

mandatory.text: enrolment at a higher education institution in Baden-Württemberg or a partner institution abroad
highly qualified undergraduate, graduate or doctoral student
want to spend 1 or 2 exchange semesters at one of the partner institutions either in Baden-Württemberg (Germany) or abroad

funding.description: The scholarship amounts to between 800 EUR and 1,400 EUR per month. Scholars also receive non-material assistance and are part of a broad international network connecting people from different disciplines and cultures.
funding.duration: The funding period ranges between 3 and 11 months.

application_rounds.notes: The date of the application deadline may vary - please contact the International Office at your higher education institution.

steps.text: The applications are exclusively handled by the International Offices; not by the Baden-Württemberg Stiftung.
For specific information on the application process, the deadline and application forms, please contact the International Office at your higher education institution.

sources.title: Baden-Württemberg Stiftung: The Baden-Württemberg-STIPENDIUM for Students - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme allows international students to spend exchange semesters physically studying in Germany (Baden-Württemberg).
